releaseNotes:
- Android: Foreground service (StreamSessionService) with WifiLock (LOW_LATENCY), WakeLock, and bindProcessToNetwork keeps session alive when app is backgrounded or screen turns off
- Android: Session token persisted to SharedPreferences — app reconnects silently after process death or Wi-Fi drop without re-pairing
- Android: ConnectivityManager.registerNetworkCallback triggers immediate reconnect when Wi-Fi returns, bypassing backoff delay
- Android: 401/403 from host now shows clear "Session expired — re-pair" message instead of infinite reconnect loop
- Android: Removed hardcoded developer subnet .33 guesses from discoverHosts fallback
- Android: SmpClient.revalidateSession() and pingHost() added for post-drop session recovery
- Android: All input handlers no longer fall back to emulator address 10.0.2.2
- Android: Implemented APK Signature Scheme v3/v3.1 rotation lineage to resolve package conflicts and preserve user data
- Windows: Embedded native application icon directly into executable PE resources and runtime window frame
- Windows: Fixed UAC elevation update failure (os error 740) by launching installer with elevated ShellExecuteW runas verb
- Display Stream: Upgraded to full-resolution 4:4:4 chroma, base JPEG quality 82, and 60 FPS target with adaptive frame-rate shedding
releaseHighlights: Android: Foreground service keeps session alive when backgrounded — no more drops on screen-off
Android: Session token persisted — reconnects silently without PIN re-entry after process restart
Android: Wi-Fi reconnect fires immediately when network returns, not after backoff timer
Android: 401/403 host responses now show clear re-pair message instead of infinite reconnect loop
Android: Removed hardcoded developer .33 subnet guesses from host discovery
Android: APK Signature Scheme v3/v3.1 rotation lineage for in-place upgrades
Windows: Embedded native icon + UAC-correct installer elevation
Display Stream: 4:4:4 chroma, quality 82, 60 FPS adaptive stream
